critical_changes: Qualify every D-based specificity verdict ('three have larger errors than a generator that makes no painter distinctions', 'only FLUX.2 Max is below that level in 94.2%') as a 31-feature result in the abstract, intro bullet 3, Sec. 5.3 and Discussion. Report D, Q and beta for CLIP and CSD with scene (and reference) intervals and P(D<1) alongside Table 3. State explicitly that GPT Image 1 goes from worst (31 features, D=1.572) to best (CLIP, D=0.847, best in 99.3% of resamples), and that all six CSD estimates are below 1. A reviewer recomputation from the released embeddings gives CSD D<1 in 100% of scene resamples for GPT Image 1, GPT Image 2, Flare and FLUX.2 Max.

Confront the validity of each representation for painter specificity. Introduce the genuine-work separability (31 features 49.8% macro accuracy vs about 80% for CLIP/CSD) where the representations are defined. Compute the genuine-painting D calibration (pooled and content-sampled) in CLIP and CSD, and report its dispersion as well as its mean: in the 31 features, content-sampled genuine draws exceed D=1 in about 29-35% of splits. Explain what is and is not concluded about each configuration's specificity given that the prespecified representation is the least discriminative. Extend Discussion recommendation 1 to require a representation-validity check and a calibration in the same representation.
minor_changes: Reword the Sec. 5.1 heading and intro bullet 1 ('as it would be for a faithful imitator'); the observed fraction is below the faithful one in 100% of resamples for five configurations. Show N/H and B/H in the main text.

Clarify that common practice (e.g. CSD GSS) uses raw prototype similarity, not gain relative to a generic clause. Explain why the conclusion transfers a fortiori, and ideally add the raw-proximity analogue of Table 2.
Qualify 'mostly' for GPT Image 2 in CSD (54.2%, scene interval [47.4, 59.3]).

Give a paired interval for texture-minus-spatial shared fraction, or remove 'texture is the least shared family' from the contribution list (spatial [57.3, 80.1] overlaps texture [61.9, 70.7]; ordering differs across configurations).

Lead the 'different readouts favor different configurations' claim with the within-CLIP contrast (proximity: Nano Banana 2; recognition: GPT Image 2; D: GPT Image 1) to avoid conflating readout with representation.
App. D p. 21: 'about twice the reference size' should read 'about twice in squared size' (1.49 times in norm, as in Sec. 5.3).
Define 'corrected cosine', lambda ('covered') and 'along generic' (cos^2(c,g)) in the main text or the Table 1 caption.
Simplify the abstract (fewer numeric ranges) while keeping representation qualifiers.
Release the 1,008 generated images, or commit to releasing them on acceptance, so features and embeddings can be re-extracted from pixels.
In Limitations, state that 'specificity' is operationalised as agreement with differences between reference means in a chosen representation, without perceptual validation.
factual_errors: Appendix D (p. 21) says GPT Image 2's between-name differences are 'about twice the reference size'; they are about twice in squared size (Q = 2.223) and 1.49 times in norm, as Sec. 5.3 states.
